description: Check the live compliance pre-screening status, uploaded document count, compliance officer remarks, and Stage 2 secure upload URL for a submitted Hong Kong corporate bank account application (BK-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX). REQUIRES USER LOGIN (personal API Key hkq_live_... obtained at https://www.86hc.com/user) plus order_id.

api_key.description: Personal 86hc.com API Key (hkq_live_xxxx) obtained after signing in at https://www.86hc.com/user (required if X-API-Key header is not configured).

contact_email.description: Applicant email address for identity verification.

contact_phone.description: Applicant phone number (or last 4+ digits) for identity verification.

order_id.description: Bank account application reference ID (e.g. BK-20261028-XXXXXX).

name: check_bank_application_status
